mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the battery and then checking the cooler on reserve made the difference between a completed circuit and a working, monitored supply concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first two guesses were corrected automatically, so the early reserve setup felt somewhat guided rather than like a decision I understood.

surprise.text: The battery remained available after producing the reserve estimate; I had assumed it had been used up and inspected the unit to find the next connection.

arbitrary.text: My attempted battery-to-switch connection lacked a clear basis beyond their apparent roles; the automatic measurement step made more sense afterward.

continue.text: I would continue: assembling the backup and verifying it under load made the repair feel consequential, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the early automatic corrections.
